title: Satellite Tile Assessment Output v1
description: A structured vision-model assessment of whether a described feature appears in one satellite-image tile and where it appears within that image.

decision.description: Whether to discard this tile, retain it and inspect smaller child tiles, or report a specific visible spot from this tile.

match.description: Whether the described feature appears to be visibly present in the attached satellite image.

score.description: Estimated likelihood that the described feature is visible in this tile, from 0 to 1. This is a ranking signal, not proof.

reason.description: Concise evidence-based explanation grounded in visible image content. For refine, explain why the region merits further inspection; for report, explain why the exact target is visible and why relativeLocation is placed on it.
examples: Lake Nockamixon is visible with cleared access areas near the shoreline, but individual parking spaces are not distinguishable at this scale.
No qualifying water-adjacent clearing is visible in this tile.

evidence.description: Visible evidence supporting the decision. Do not include evidence that cannot be seen in the image.

relativeLocation.description: Estimated target location within the attached image using normalized image coordinates. For refine, identify the promising subregion to inspect next. For report, identify the exact requested target itself, not nearby context or the tile center.

x.description: West-to-east image position: 0 is the west/left edge and 1 is the east/right edge.

y.description: North-to-south image position: 0 is the north/top edge and 1 is the south/bottom edge.

targetBounds.description: Approximate normalized image bounds of the visible target or promising subregion. west/east are horizontal coordinates and north/south are vertical coordinates. For report, these bounds must enclose the exact visible target.

west.description: Left/west edge of the target in normalized image coordinates.

north.description: Top/north edge of the target in normalized image coordinates.

east.description: Right/east edge of the target in normalized image coordinates.

south.description: Bottom/south edge of the target in normalized image coordinates.

examples.reason: Lake Nockamixon is visible with cleared access areas near the shoreline, but individual parking spaces are not distinguishable at this scale.
